name: compact-adviser
description: Suggests (or, opt-in, runs) /compact at a completed checkpoint, judged by OpenAI's Decisions API or TypeSafe Jev. Its hooks module activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: hint shows advice; auto compacts at eligible checkpoints and, once you walk away, compacts a finished session or keeps an unfinished session's prompt cache warm, after a first-use confirmation from /compact-adviser; off disables the adviser (Claude Code's own auto-compact is unaffected).

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: Which model answers the two checkpoint questions: decisions (OpenAI's Decisions API, gpt-6-luna; key OPENAI_DECISIONS_API_KEY) or jev (TypeSafe; key TYPESAFE_API_KEY). Each judge has its own key and floor schedule.

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: A constant token count, not a percentage; no judgment below it.

contextBudgetTokens.title: Context budget (tokens)
contextBudgetTokens.description: Optional. The context size you want compacted by: the hint floor relaxes as the context approaches the smaller of it and Claude Code's auto-compact point (or the window). 0 turns it off.

logRequests.title: Log judge requests
logRequests.description: When on, each judge request and sanitized outcome is appended to ~/.claude/compact-adviser-requests-<session-id>.jsonl. Off by default. Never logs an API key.

profile.title: Judge profile JSON
profile.description: Optional version-1 judge profile JSON. Empty uses shipped defaults. Invalid profiles disable advice. This does not grant auto consent.

beforeCompactPrompt.title: Before-compact prompt
beforeCompactPrompt.description: Optional. Empty keeps automatic compaction immediate. In confirmed auto mode, a non-empty value runs as one turn, then compaction runs if that turn ends in a settled answer. A value that starts with / is a slash command (for example /stow); Claude Code does not expand slash commands or @file mentions in a plugin prompt, and it rejects a plugin prompt that starts with /. If you send your own prompt or run a command in between, or that turn is interrupted, errors, or does not finish within 5 minutes, nothing is compacted.

idleMinutes.title: Walk-away minutes
idleMinutes.description: Automatic mode only. Minutes after a settled answer, with no prompt, command or typing, before it compacts a finished session or keeps an unfinished one's prompt cache warm. 0 follows the cache TTL: 50 minutes on a 1-hour cache, 4 on a 5-minute cache, 50 when the TTL is unknown.

keepWarmHours.title: Keep-warm hours
keepWarmHours.description: Automatic mode only. How long it keeps an unfinished session's prompt cache warm after you walk away, with a one-line background request on your model quota each cache cycle. It also stops once the pings would cost as much as one cache rebuild. 0 turns keep-warm off.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Saved from /compact-adviser. Hidden in /config so the value is never shown. A non-empty TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the launch environment wins. Do not commit this value.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Saved from /compact-adviser for the decisions judge. Hidden in /config so the value is never shown. A non-empty OPENAI_DECISIONS_API_KEY in the launch environment wins. Do not commit this value.
